source.text:
9. And when the lines containing the angle are
straight then the angle is called rectilinear.

source_claims.requirement: Apply the definition to an angle and its own containing sides.
Preserve the condition on the containing lines.
Define the rectilinear classification under that condition without losing the inherited angle conditions.

interpretation_decisions.question: How are general plane angles from definition 8 distinguished from the rectilinear subclass?

review_failure_probes: Do not classify an arbitrary pair of straight lines as an angle without the inherited angle conditions.
